title: Revisable work
summary: A delivered piece of work can be changed without being redone.

answer_carries: the signed job manifest of that completion
or a typed answer that it has none: no manifest for that task, or the task is unknown to it

exchanges.asks: what would redoing these steps cost now?
answer_carries: each named step with its flat price, amount_micro and currency
included_remaining, how many included revisions are left
window_ends_at, when the revision window closes, or null

exchanges.request: a request on the offering that produced the work
input: the change, in the request's text
answer_carries: the task completed like any other
a new job manifest, in which every piece not redone carries the same reference and digest as before
the manifest's reused member, counting those pieces
